training.cold_start: zero weights; no proof, certificate or previously learned policy
training.reuse: same six assertions; evaluation adds a third unused theory axiom. This is a same-problem distractor control, not held-out mathematical generalization.
training.reward: verified kernel target minus actual inference-command cost; failed proposals receive -0.5

conformance.domain: all doubled-grid rectangle centers, integer capacity one; every center root generation zero
conformance.markings: four edge colors; optional analytically redundant neighbor values, not learned failure markings
conformance.inventory: literal finite TM transitions; complete zero/one-head Wang triples in four exhaustive Cartesian blocks
conformance.graph: one shared candidate per center/triple; all four colors and extended dependencies maintained
conformance.scheduler: global dead, global forced, earliest generation; all roots zero, placed generation one
conformance.rollback: unchanged independently tested lazy Wang trail
conformance.proposals: valid first-order inference sequences translated to rectangle preferences; full base alternatives retained
conformance.verification: independent rule inventory, direct TM rows and point sums/marks, decoded kernel derivation
conformance.unknown: all finite limits are unknown; exhausted rectangle applies only to that envelope/certificate/height

limitations: finite catalogs are compiled before search; no single fixed unbounded serialized-AST checker yet
fair syntax enumeration is expressively complete relative to Kernel but computationally expensive
finite closed axioms only; checked infinite theory schemas remain open
compiler and semantic kernel have executable checks, not a formalized correctness proof
the six assertion controls do not establish practical mathematical proof-search performance
